title: The Strength Protocol
author: Field notes for Harsh Kasana
description: A gym manual built around one idea: you cannot look up what your body does, you can only measure it. Charts for typing yourself honestly (frame, body fat, training age, response profile), a program you can actually run, the eating rules that have real numbers behind them, and a 12-week experiment loop for finding your own answers — with what the research, the standard books, and thousands of Reddit and Quora progress reports agree on, and where they don't.
